1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 1196 of 2019 under
Sections 304B, 498A, 201, 506 Ipc and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sector 39
Noida, District Gautambudha Nagar, with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place about two years prior to the incident.
The allegation that applicant used to harass the deceased on account of dowry, is wholly false.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that only some hot talk has taken place between the applicant and deceased and she has committed suicide in anger.

sentences.text: the parental family of deceased was informed and the cremation was done with their consent.
The allegation that the cremation was done hurriedly before reaching of the family members of deceased, is wholly false.

Learned counsel has referred statements of the independent witnesses, recorded during investigation, and submitted that the allegation of dowry demand and harassment of deceased by applicant, is false.
It was stated that the child of the applicant is residing with parents of applicant and thus the presence of the applicant is required for looking after the child.

Lastly it was submitted that applicant accused is languishing in jail since 20.11.2019 having no criminal history and that he has already undergone the detention of more than four years and that in trial only one witness has been examined so far.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application and submitted that there are allegations that applicant has harassed the deceased on account of dowry and after incident the deceased was cremated before reaching of her family members.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, the period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Prasanjeet, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 17.1.2024 Kumar Manish.
